# Social Image Sizer

> Free browser tool that resizes one image to every major social media size in 2026 and downloads them one at a time or as a ZIP. Nothing is uploaded; all cropping happens on a canvas in the browser. It has a draggable focal point, per-size zoom, safe-zone overlays where platforms cover the image, and JPG/PNG/WebP export with quality control.

URL: https://mizoz.github.io/social-image-sizer/
Source: https://github.com/mizoz/social-image-sizer
Last updated: 2026-10-21

## Sizes it exports (pixels)

| Platform | Placement | Size | Ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| Instagram | Post, square | 1080x1080 | 1:1 |
| Instagram | Post, portrait | 1080x1350 | 4:5 |
| Instagram | Story | 1080x1920 | 9:16 (keep top and bottom 250 px clear) |
| Instagram | Reel cover | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |
| Facebook | Feed post | 1080x1350 | 4:5 |
| Facebook | Cover photo | 1640x624 | displays 820x312 desktop, 640x360 phone |
| Facebook | Event cover | 1920x1005 | 1.91:1 |
| LinkedIn | Post / link image | 1200x627 | 1.91:1 |
| LinkedIn | Personal profile banner | 1584x396 | 4:1 |
| LinkedIn | Company page cover | 1512x256 | official LinkedIn Pages spec |
| LinkedIn | Article / newsletter cover | 1920x1080 | 16:9 |
| X | Post image | 1600x900 | 16:9 (recommended) |
| X | Header | 1500x500 | 3:1 |
| YouTube | Thumbnail (HD) | 1280x720 | 16:9, fits the 2 MB phone upload limit |
| YouTube | Thumbnail (4K) | 3840x2160 | 16:9, YouTube's current recommendation |
| YouTube | Channel banner | 2560x1440 | safe area 1546x423 |
| TikTok | Photo / video cover | 1080x1920 | 9:16, safe area 880x1220 (recommended) |
| Pinterest | Standard pin | 1000x1500 | 2:3 |
| Threads | Post image | 1080x1350 | 4:5 (recommended) |
| Bluesky | Post image | 1200x675 | 16:9 (recommended) |
| Bluesky | Profile banner | 3000x1000 | 3:1 (recommended) |
| Google | Business Profile photo | 720x720 | 1:1 |
| Web | Open Graph / link preview | 1200x630 | 1.91:1 |
